title: Safety Helmet
description: Transform your Netherite Helmet into a yellow construction safety helmet with a custom 3D model in inventory and unique texture when worn.
body:
# Safety Helmet - Netherite Helmet Resource Pack

Transform your Netherite Helmet into a professional yellow construction safety helmet with this immersive resource pack!

## Features
- **Custom 3D Model**: The Netherite Helmet displays as a detailed yellow hard hat when held in your inventory
- **Worn Texture**: When equipped, the helmet features a unique safety helmet design with realistic construction equipment aesthetics
- **Perfect for Builders**: Ideal for construction-themed servers, creative mode building, and survival projects
- **High Quality**: Custom-textured model maintains Minecraft's visual style while adding a professional touch

## Perfect For
- Construction and building-themed servers
- Creative mode builders who want unique armor aesthetics
- Roleplay servers with themed content
- Building tutorials and videos with a professional look

## Compatibility
- Compatible with Minecraft Java Edition
- No other mods required

Put on your safety helmet and build with confidence!
